create_heightfield_terrain_programmatic: create a PyBullet heightfield terrain from programmatic random height data using GEOM_HEIGHTFIELD collision shape
create_heightfield_terrain_png: create a PyBullet heightfield terrain from a PNG heightmap file with an overlay texture
create_multibody_with_joints: create a PyBullet multi-body object with revolute joints and link collision shapes
update_heightfield_dynamically: update a PyBullet heightfield terrain shape at runtime by replacing height data with new random values
